claude-sdk-quick-connect.title: Connect local Claude SDK
claude-sdk-quick-connect.intro: Check the local installation, choose a fixed model and credential reference, then connect the execution node.
claude-sdk-quick-connect.desktop_require: Connect local Claude SDK in the desktop app, or use an existing execution node.
claude-sdk-quick-connect.storage_failed: The local configuration draft could not be saved or read. Review it before connecting; the original connection can still be checked or stopped.
claude-sdk-quick-connect.version_unsuppo: This installation version is unsupported. Prepare Claude Code 2.1.314, then check again.
claude-sdk-quick-connect.model_hint: Enter an available Claude model ID. Connecting does not switch models automatically or request a model.
claude-sdk-quick-connect.credential_hint: Enter only the name of an existing local environment variable, never its secret value.
claude-sdk-quick-connect.draft_not_adopt: This draft has not been confirmed as applied. Check the original connection first. To apply this configuration, explicitly stop the original node and then connect.
claude-sdk-quick-connect.boundary: Installation, node connection, profile registration and enablement are confirmed separately. Consult execution records for model authentication, the actual model, usage and cost.
